case_title: CITY OF PHILADELPHIA vs. FIORENTINO, JOSEPH

docket_entries.description: APPLICATION FOR ENTRY OF SISTER STATE JUDGMENT; NOTICE OF SISTER STATE JUDGMENT ISSUED FILED BY PLAINTIFF CITY OF PHILADELPHIA AS TO DEFENDANT FIORENTINO, JOSEPH

UNDER APPLICATION TO THE CLERK FOR JUDGMENT UNDER SEC 1710.25 C.C.P., IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF CITY OF PHILADELPHIA RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT FIORENTINO, JOSEPH $5,042.00 PRINCIPAL, $1,058.62 INTEREST, $80.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $6,180.62 ALL FURTHER PROCESSING TO BE DONE BY DEFAULT SECTION
